visdrone_night_plaza.title: Night square from a drone

taco_cup.model: D-FINE-seg X instance segmentation fine-tuned on TACO (59 classes), conf 0.5
taco_cup.notes: 640x640, COCO init. TACO val: box mAP50 0.363, F1 0.388 (TensorRT F1 0.380 vs YOLO26-seg X 0.300 in the repo benchmark). A hard, long-tail dataset - these images are hand-picked examples where the model is right.

radio_galaxies.title: Radio galaxies and their host galaxies
radio_galaxies.caption: Radio galaxies from the EMU pilot survey with the infrared galaxy that hosts each one.
radio_galaxies.dataset: RadioGalaxyNET (Gupta et al., PASA 2024; CSIRO DAP 61068)
radio_galaxies.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (images re-rendered for display: infrared gray, radio amber)
radio_galaxies.model: D-FINE-seg S keypoints (1 host keypoint), trained on RadioGalaxyNET train, conf 0.5, class-agnostic NMS
radio_galaxies.notes: Picked among images the model gets fully right (all sources, right class, host OKS >= 0.5, no extra boxes). Benchmark: 67.1 box AP / 70.5 host keypoint AP vs Gal-DINO 53.7 / 48.1, repo radiogalaxynet-dfine-vs-galdino.
